g.text: Open Source Intelligence Event Intelligence Pipeline • Modular Monolith Architecture
All visitors access every route freely
Live military event cards, category tags,
Real-time status polling & phase JSON logs
• State Management: Atomic Run Lock (`pipeline_status.running` flag prevents concurrent runs with 409 Conflict)
• Wipe-First Policy: Cleans MongoDB collections + ChromaDB vectors on start (preserves `sources` only)
• Structured Observability: Emits detailed phase JSON metrics (items processed, errors, latency) persisted to `pipeline_logs`
MANUALLY TRIGGERED PIPELINE STAGES (STRICT SEQUENTIAL EXECUTION)
DATA TRANSFORMATION LIFECYCLE (PER RUN WIPE → RE-INDEX):
At completion of each phase, a structured JSON status report is appended to `pipeline_logs` and broadcast to `/status`.
QUERY & ASSISTANT RUNTIME SERVICES (READ-ONLY PUBLIC OPERATIONS)
• Top-K event retrieval from vector store
Motor Async Mongo Client • ChromaDB Persistent Client • LLM Client (HTTPX 6-8s timeout) • Embedding Client
Preserves `sources` only • Drops all articles & events
BGE / E5 vectors matched with Mongo `_id`
Centroid semantic vectors for search & RAG
Targeted military portals, defense releases & OSINT channels
1. Strictly NO Authentication / JWT / User Sessions
2. Manual Trigger Only (No cron or background schedulers)
